report.summary: Pass. The change removes the roles and custom-agent APIs, the Artifacts store and roles settings, and moves session metadata to flat agentId/agentName/agentVersion/agentSha fields. SQLite migration 0012 renames the columns in place, so stored profiles and commit SHAs survive. Stored settings that still hold a roles key decode without error because extra keys are ignored by default. Library sessions are still resolved in the Worker with the ownership check. The new frozen-model behaviour, and the owner's waiver of Artifacts imports, are written into tabs 01, 02 and 08 and IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md. Two non-blocking issues: the Mac app still lists an empty 'Roles' project settings page, and old migrated runs with no agentVersion use a different model rule in the start check than at session start. I could not run typecheck, lint or tests because node_modules is missing from the worktree; the review is from reading the code.

findings.text: The Mac project settings page list still has a 'Roles' page whose section was removed from settings_model::SECTIONS. On Mac it now opens empty, while the web client dropped the page. This breaks web/Mac parity (CLAUDE.md rule 17; tabs 04/07). Remove the entry and shrink the array to 7.

evidence.why: SECTIONS no longer contains "Roles", so the page shows no fields but is still offered to the user. The web test no longer lists this page.

findings.text: The run pre-start check in runs.ts always passes frozen=true. Session start only treats the session as frozen when the row's agentVersion is set. Runs from the older migration can have a null agent_version, so for them the check and the actual start can choose different models. This only affects legacy runs; a test that starts a pending run with no version would confirm it.

evidence.quote: const model = sessionModel(agent, config, core.settings(), session.agentVersion !== null);
evidence.why: runs.ts calls sessionModel(agent, { model: definition.model }, this.core.settings(), true) and copies agentVersion: row.agentVersion into the session row, and that value may be null for migrated runs.

checked.risk: Real contracts: SQLite migration, package exports, removed Artifacts binding, generated Rust types
Failure paths and stored-data compatibility (old settings with a roles key, protected-file errors)
Idempotency and state: session columns, model freezing, one-time library migration
Security: ownership checks, roles folder removed from daemon file access, no secrets
Tests: waiting for observable state, assertions that actually check something, case budgets
Build environment: turbo inputs, test optimizer configs, lockfile
